blocks.heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What are global immersion programs in business education?
a: Global immersion programs are short-term international learning experiences where students travel abroad to study at top universities, visit leading companies and engage with diverse cultures. At ATLAS ISME, these immersions span 10+ countries across 5 continents and include campus visits, corporate tours, academic sessions and networking events at institutions like Imperial College, King's College London, Columbia University and NYU, helping students develop a real-world global business perspective.

items.q: What is Masters Progression and how does it work for Indian business graduates?
a: Masters Progression is a structured pathway that helps ATLAS ISME graduates gain admission to top postgraduate programs at universities abroad. A dedicated Masters Progression team works one-on-one with students on university selection, SOP writing and interview preparation. Over 400 students have been placed in global Master's programs at institutions including Oxford, NYU, King's College, University of Bath and Manchester, with access to 125+ scholarships and 100+ global university partners.

items.q: How does international exposure improve job placement outcomes?
a: International exposure builds cross-cultural communication, global business acumen and confidence which includes global immersions, international faculty masterclasses, summer schools and exchange programs, ensures students graduate with a worldview and professional network that sets them apart in competitive job markets both in India and abroad.

items.q: Can Indian BBA students participate in international summer schools?
a: Yes. ATLAS ISME BBA students actively participate in international summer schools at top universities worldwide. In 2025 alone, 80+ students attended programs across 17 cities in 10 countries, including London School of Economics, King's College, Parsons New York, UAL, IED Milan, Yonsei University, Seoul National University and NTU Singapore, earning credits and gaining real global exposure as part of their degree.

items.q: Do global university partnerships affect the quality of education in India?
a: Yes, significantly. ATLAS ISME's 60+ MoUs with universities across the US, UK, Europe, Australia and Asia bring global standards directly into the Indian classroom. These partnerships enable international faculty residencies, visiting faculty bootcamps, collaborative masterclasses and curriculum benchmarking, meaning students don't just hear about global practices, they learn from professors at institutions like Imperial College London, Babson College and Manchester Metropolitan University, right on campus.
